Base= Superhuman Physical Characteristics, Weapon Mastery (Primarily wields staves to use magic. Wields a katana in 4GO), Adept in martial arts, Transformation (Into White Sister Rom with HDD [Hard Drive Divinity]), Fourth Wall Awareness, Acrobatics, Healing (Transforming into her goddess form fully restores her HP and SP. Also with "I'll Heal You" and "You're Okay"), Acausality (Types 1, 3, and 4; Was unaffected by having the entirety of Hyper Dimension's history itself being rewritten and even normal citizens kept their memories after the world was rewritten. It's explained by Histoire that time and causality splits people's past and future into multiple timelines to protect them from paradoxes and causal changes), Flight, Immortality (Types 1, 3, 4, 8; As a goddess, Rom cannot age, as age does not apply to goddesses. The Player can simply resurrect her or reload a save file if she loses at all. CPUs are reliant upon Share Energy and so long as there are shares, they can indefinitely revive themselves. Auto-Raise [should have it from scaling to Neptune] automatically resurrects her whenever she dies or is knocked out in battle.), Large Size (Type 11), Beyond-Dimensional Physiology (As with all other entities in the Neptunia series, her existence is beyond the concept of numerical dimensionality, as all beings evolved alongside Gamindustri into beyond dimensional existences), Fate and Plot Manipulation (Passive; Scaling from Neptune, as any protagonists should have it based on Neptune's statements and showings [Rom was one of the protagonists for a period of time in Megadimension]. Should have similar capabilities to that of Blanc and Noire, whom prevented a boss battle so the player didn't have to waste their time with it), Forcefield Creation, Self-Sustenance (Types 1, 2, and likely 3; CPUs have repeatedly displayed a lack of need for breathing in several continuities. As noted and displayed in Victory/RB3, CPUs do not require sustenance to stay alive and cannot starve to death. CPUs can remain in active combat with no rest for billions of years with no sign of tiredness, as displayed in the original Hyperdimension Neptunia, where the four CPUs have fought for eons.), Abstract Existence (Type 2; Goddesses are born from and are embodiments of Share Energy and won't perish so long as they have it), Conceptual Manipulation (Share Energy wielders can freely manipulate it to their whim. Share Energy is directly stated to be the concepts of will, faith, emotion, and desire. Share Energy can erase the true form of the Deity of Sin from existence by killing its manifestation, with the True Deity of Sin being abstract and conceptual in nature.), Hammerspace, Blessed (The Player can grant her the ability to One Shot opponents, give her Invulnerability, and/or weaken the opponent), Share Energy Manipulation (Lower End Applications), Information Analysis (The Observation Scope and Analyser allow her to analyze information of a foe, including but not limited to: heart rate, temperature, item drops, held items, health, stamina, statistics, and resistances), Weapon Creation (Can create her weapons out of nothing on the fly in just a couple of seconds), Extrasensory Perception (Can sense various forms of energy, including share energy and negative energy), Positive Emotion Empowerment (As a goddess she gains strength from share energy, which is consistently regarded to as positive emotions like hopes, desires, prayers, and faith. Share energy has also been referred to as the opposite to negative energy.), Non-Physical Interaction (Regular enemies include ghosts and beings made of data), Durability Negation, Damage Boost (Via Critical hits), Enhanced Senses (Sneaking Eye shows what the enemies can see), Perception Manipulation (Thanks to the White Orb, enemies won't attack unless they're attacked first), Regeneration (High-Godly; She can passively heal off damage from the remade Dark CPUs, which have Conceptual Manipulation due to possessing the abilities of the Next Form users.), Status Effect Inducement (In the form of Paralysis, Poison and Power Nullification), Magic (via various attacks), Elemental Manipulation (Of Water, Fire, Ice, Electricity, Earth, Poison, Air, Light, and Darkness through various attacks. She has the option of infusing one or more of these elements into her every attack [Scaling off of Neptune].), Absolute Zero Ice (Was taught to use Absolute Zero ice attacks by her older sister), Limiter Removal (Through Game Discs or The Player), Power Modification (With patches, which can modify what type of damage her weapon does), Glyph Creation, Resurrection (When she is knocked out or killed, she can resurrect via Auto-Raise. Also via "Come Back" and "Energy!"), Power Bestowal (everyone in RB2's ending gave their powers to Nepgear to fight the Deity of Sin.), Energy Manipulation and Projection (via various attacks), Life Manipulation (With the Dark Ring, Rom can manipulate the life force of all creatures)
